WHY: Captures a genuine cryptographic impossibility invariant — publicly verifiable authorship is incompatible with plausible deniability, so power must be scoped symmetrically to a shared secret (insiders get forgery power too). This principle generalizes to any deniable-comms or group-attribution design and is worth percolating.
